annotations.title: Suggest a place Meridian Dispatch does not cover yet

description: Suggest a town, sight, walk, museum, event, ski resort, food area or hotel that Meridian Dispatch has no page for, so the desk can research and add it to this free, shared travel reference. Use it only when the traveller asks you to, or agrees when you offer, for somewhere the guides do not cover (search_guides or get_destination found nothing) that is real and open. Do not call it on your own for places you recommend or put in a plan. Single restaurants, bars and shops are not listed; a food street, market or bar district is. source_url is required: the place's official website or another current page showing it exists. A place already covered returns its page instead of a suggestion. Nothing is published straight away: the desk researches every suggestion first. The same place suggested twice is recorded once. Returns whether it was received.

kind.description: What it is. stay is a hotel worth the trip in itself.

name.description: The place's proper name, e.g. "Lake Bohinj".

source_url.description: The place's official website, or another current page showing it exists and is open.

town.description: The nearest town, when the place is not a town itself.

why.description: One or two sentences: what it is and why a traveller would go. Facts only, no prices.
